coverage_broad.explantion: Both responses are criticised for lacking context, missing major aspects, and being too narrow. coverage_deep.explantion: Response b supplies a concrete list of alleged mental‑health-related effects (dizziness, fatigue, digestion issues, agitation, unusual dreams, creativity spikes, relationship difficulties) and even mentions a safety warning for eye exposure. consistency_internal.explantion: Both responses exhibit the same categories of internal‑consistency failures, but Response b separates belief‑based statements from factual ones more often (e.g., using "some people believe" and "might also have"), whereas Response a presents astrological and scientific claims as a single unified body and concludes with an unqualified universal benefit.
